sections.title: Added
items: Every API call identifies the plugin with `X-WABEK-Client: wordpress/<version>` and the store host with `X-WABEK-Site`, so the WABEK admin can see which plugin versions are in use. No customer data is sent in these headers.

sections.title: Added
items: Template language setting (default `ar`) and named or numbered (positional) template variables, sent as `template_language` / `template_params`.
`Idempotency-Key` header on every send, reused across retries of the same queued message; `409 idempotency_in_progress` is retried later.
"Check delivery" in the send log (`GET /api/v1/message-status`), stored per message.
Opt-out sync with WABEK contacts (`POST /api/v1/contacts-opt-out`) when a customer opts out/in in My Account or withdraws/renews consent at checkout.
OTP codes are sent from the store's selected number with the store name (`instance_id`, `brand_name`).

sections.title: Changed
items: Number list comes from `GET /api/v1/instances` (default number marked); the manual instance ID moved under "Advanced". Without a selection the account's default number is used.

changelog.notes: First release of the rewritten plugin (slug `wabek-whatsapp`), replacing "WAABEK for WooCommerce".

sections.title: Added
items: Customer WhatsApp notifications for new order, processing, completed, cancelled, refunded, on-hold, failed and notes to customer, each with its own switch, message editor and optional approved template + named variables for messages outside the 24-hour window.
Store owner alert for new orders.
Background sending through Action Scheduler (WP-Cron fallback) with retries after 1, 5 and 15 minutes for timeouts and 5xx responses; 4xx responses are never retried.
Send log (latest 200 messages, masked phone numbers) with "Resend" and "Clear log".
WhatsApp consent checkbox for the classic and block checkout, optional "consent required" mode and My Account opt-out.
Optional abandoned cart reminder (one reminder, configurable delay, cart restore link).
Optional WhatsApp OTP login and registration number verification with local rate limits.
E.164 phone normalization (billing country → default country → store base country), including Arabic-Indic digits.
Connection test that validates the API key and lists WhatsApp numbers when the server supports it.
One-time import of the old plugin's API key, API URL, number and admin phone; warning while the old plugin is still active.
HPOS and Cart & Checkout blocks compatibility declarations.
English source strings, Arabic (Modern Standard Arabic) translation, RTL admin styles.

sections.title: Security
items: API key sent only in the `X-API-Key` header over verified HTTPS, redirects disabled, key masked in the UI and never logged.
Capability checks and nonces on every form and AJAX handler; sanitized input, escaped output, prepared SQL.

sections.title: Fixed
items: **Phone fields in the admin area (Send test, Send message, client profile override)** now work with WHMCS's own country picker: the chosen calling code (`country-calling-code-<field>`) is combined with the national number, a trunk "0" or a re-typed country code is removed, and a full number starting with `+` or `00` still wins. Previously a number typed after the picker's default `+1` was rejected with "No valid WhatsApp number".
Arabic-Indic and Persian digits are accepted in phone numbers.
Clearer error message when a number is invalid.

changelog.notes: The per-client "receive WhatsApp notifications" choice is now visible and editable natively in the admin area and on the client's own pages, in every theme (six, twenty-one, Nexus, Lagom 1, Lagom 2), without theme edits.

sections.title: Added
items: **Native client custom field "Receive WhatsApp notifications"** (tickbox; name from the lang files, e.g. `استقبال إشعارات واتساب / Receive WhatsApp notifications`, plus per-language translations for WHMCS *Enable Translations*). Created once on activate / upgrade / settings save (setting *Show a native "Receive WhatsApp notifications" field to clients*, default on), shown on the registration form, the checkout of new accounts, *Account details* and the admin client profile — themes print client custom fields themselves. Kept in **two-way sync** with `mod_wabek_consent`:

field → consent: `ClientAdd` and `ClientEdit` read the submitted value (or the stored one, e.g. API `UpdateClient`) and record a changed choice through the same path as the preferences page (queue clean-up + `contacts-opt-out` sync);
consent → field: every change elsewhere (preferences page, homepage panel, admin toggle, profile tab, consent tab, checkout box) writes the field.

Values are backfilled when the field is created and rewritten when the consent mode changes. In opt-out mode the box starts ticked on the registration / checkout forms (WHMCS tickboxes have no default), never on a re-displayed form.
An opt-out field configured in 4.0 / 4.1 (*ticked = no WhatsApp*) is reused with that meaning — no second field is created. New setting *A ticked box means* (receive / opt-out).

**Admin client summary:** the `AdminAreaClientSummaryPage` box is now a compact Bootstrap 3 admin panel with the WhatsApp number (and where it comes from), on/off with the recorded state, the verified badge, the last message (time, status / delivery status, event) and buttons *Turn off / Turn on WhatsApp notifications* (POST + CSRF token to the addon, back to `clientssummary.php?userid=…` with a confirmation), *Send message* and *Log*.
**Admin action links** (`AdminAreaClientSummaryActionLinks`): *Send WhatsApp message*, *WhatsApp log*.

**Admin profile tab** (`AdminClientProfileTabFields` / `…Save`): *Receive WhatsApp notifications* (Yes/No select when no consent custom field is active; otherwise the status and a pointer to the native field, so two controls never overwrite each other) and an optional *WhatsApp number* override (stored in `mod_wabek_consent.phone_override`, used before the profile phone; not shown when a phone custom field is configured).

**Client-area homepage panel** (`ClientAreaHomepagePanels`, menu API): on/off state, the number messages go to, a one-click on/off button (POST + token) and *Manage preferences*; markup per theme family, RTL-aware.
**Account sidebar:** *WhatsApp notifications* with an On/Off badge in the *My Account* panel of the account pages.
`tests/consent-sync.php` (SQLite through illuminate/database) and homepage-panel / admin-summary checks and screenshots in `tests/render-check.php`.

sections.title: Changed
items: Preferences page copy: "WhatsApp notifications are on / off for your account — messages are sent to +…" with a single toggle button.
The checkout consent box is not printed for new accounts when the native field is already on the order form.
Arabic: "Off" is now «موقوفة».

sections.title: Fixed
items: The client summary box could disappear silently: any failure returned an empty string. Each part is now guarded and logged (`WABEK: client summary box (…) failed`) and the box always renders (with a minimal fallback).

sections.title: Added
items: **Theme-native client area.** The active client-area theme is detected (template variable, WHMCS `Theme::factory()`, `?systpl=` session, `Template` setting; child themes followed through the `parent:` key of `theme.yaml`; unknown themes sniffed for their Bootstrap version) and the pages are rendered from `templates/bs3/` (six, Lagom 1.x, other Bootstrap 3 themes), `templates/bs4/` (twenty-one, Nexus, other Bootstrap 4/5 themes, and the default) or `templates/lagom2/` (Lagom 2.x and its child themes). Each set uses the theme's own panels / cards / Lagom sections, buttons, alerts, labels / badges and form controls, so it takes the theme's colours, light/dark style and RTL.

**WhatsApp consent checkbox at checkout** (optional, setting *Show a WhatsApp consent checkbox at checkout*). Printed through `ShoppingCartCheckoutOutput`, so it works in every order form (standard_cart, premium/pure/supreme comparison, universal/cloud slider, boxes, Lagom, Lagom One Step, Nexus) without template edits. A changed choice is recorded with source `checkout` (new clients before the welcome message is queued).
Sidebar panel on the module pages and a theme-aware WhatsApp icon on the Account menu item (FA4 / v4-shims class on Bootstrap 3 themes, FA5/6 brands elsewhere), both through the WHMCS menu API.
French, German, Spanish and Turkish texts for the client area and checkout (other strings fall back to English).
`tests/`: template / theme-detection checks and a Playwright screenshot harness (Bootstrap 3.4.1 and 4.6.2, simulated six, Lagom 1, twenty-one and Lagom 2 light/dark, LTR and RTL, 390px and 1280px).

sections.title: Changed
items: The client pages no longer carry their own branded header and inline `<style>`; the small stylesheet `assets/client.css` is scoped to `.wabek-ca` / `.wabek-co`, loaded only on `index.php?m=wabek` (and the checkout step when the checkbox is on) and uses Lagom / Bootstrap colour variables.

`templates/preferences.tpl` and `templates/verify.tpl` (still the `templatefile` WHMCS loads) are now thin shims that include the variant set from the absolute path in `$wabekTplDir`, falling back to `templates/bs4/`.
The WhatsApp-code-after-login redirect never touches the theme's login, logout or password-reset pages.

changelog.notes: Complete rewrite of the addon (no code from 3.x).

sections.title: Added
items: PSR-4 `WABEK\` library under `lib/`, Capsule schema created on activate and versioned migrations on upgrade.

Client notifications for 18 events (accounts, billing, orders, services, support, domains) and 3 admin alerts, each with English and Modern Standard Arabic texts, merge fields, a per-event "critical" flag and an optional approved template for outside the 24-hour window.
Daily reminders: X days before due, on the due date, X days after due, domain renewals — de-duplicated per invoice/domain and day offset.

Queue + send log (`mod_wabek_outbox`) processed by `AfterCronJob` with a cron lock, exponential backoff on 5xx / 429 / network errors, no retry on other 4xx, immediate send for critical messages with fallback to the queue.

Admin area: overview, settings with connection test, notification editor with sample sends, filtered send log with resend/cancel, manual send, bulk messages by product / service status / client status, consent management. Branded, RTL-aware UI.
Client area: WhatsApp preferences page (POST + CSRF) and WhatsApp verification page; optional WhatsApp code after login.
E.164 normalisation from the WHMCS phone number and client country, with an optional custom-field override.
Import of 3.x API settings (re-encrypted) and opt-outs.

Platform API integration: every message is sent with `type: "notification"` and an `Idempotency-Key` per outbox row (`409 idempotency_in_progress` is retried); approved templates take a language and named or positional parameters; instances are listed by `GET /api/v1/instances`; opt-ins/opt-outs are mirrored with `POST /api/v1/contacts-opt-out`; delivery status can be checked from the send log (`GET /api/v1/message-status`); OTP codes are sent from the default instance with the WHMCS company name as `brand_name`.

sections.title: Security
items: API key encrypted with WHMCS `encrypt()`, masked in the UI, sent only in the `X-API-Key` header, redacted from `logModuleCall`.
CSRF token on every POST; all state changes are POST-only; output escaped; inputs validated against allow-lists.
cURL with HTTPS-only, TLS verification, no redirects and connect/total timeouts.

sections.title: Fixed (compared with 3.x)
items: Client opt-in/opt-out was a GET request without CSRF protection.
OTP verification was routed to the wrong handler and never succeeded.
